# CEA Power Intelligence

> Southeast European electricity market intelligence terminal by Centar za energetske analize (CEA): day-ahead prices, cross-border flows and spreads, fundamentals, forwards, PPA and battery analytics for twelve SEE markets and their connected neighbours.

Market figures come from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform and are labelled by provenance (live, observed, stale, synthetic, not connected). Valuation tools state their formulas and exclusions. Nothing on the site is trading or investment advice.

## Workspaces

- [Command Center](/dashboard): Regional map with price, flow, schedule, spread, utilisation, capacity-price and generation layers.
- [Price Analytics](/dashboard/prices): Multi-market day-ahead price comparison, profiles, duration curves, heat calendar and correlations.
- [Cross-Border](/dashboard/borders): Border scanner with spreads, physical and scheduled flows, capacity and illustrative route economics.
- [Fundamentals](/dashboard/fundamentals): Generation mix, load and renewable output against day-ahead forecasts.
- [Forwards & Forecast](/dashboard/futures): Futures snapshots and forward curves.
- [PPA Studio](/dashboard/ppa): Capture price, contract settlement and valuation for solar, wind and baseload PPAs.
- [BESS Lab](/dashboard/bess): Battery dispatch optimisation and investment case on day-ahead prices.
- [RES Capture](/dashboard/capture): Serbian solar and wind capture prices.
- [Project Economics](/dashboard/calculator): LCOE, IRR and NPV for solar, wind, BESS and hybrid projects.
- [CEA Market Report](/dashboard/market-report): Export-ready market report.
- [Data & Methodology](/dashboard/methodology): Sources, formulas and their limits.
